verses.text: For di 24th day of dis month, di pikin dem of Israel gather together with fasting, wearing sackcloth and with dust on dem.
Di family of Israel separate dem self from all strangers. Dem stand and confess dem sins and di wrong of dem papa dem.
Dem stand for dem place and read di book of di law of di Lord dem God for one fourth part of di day, and for another fourth part dem confess and worship di Lord dem God.
Den Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani and Chenani stand for di steps of di Levites and cry with loud voice to di Lord dem God.

Den di Levites, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah and Pethahiah, talk say, “Stand up and bless di Lord una God from forever to forever. Make dem bless your glorious name, wey dey high above all blessing and praise.

You, even you, na di Lord alone. You don make heaven, di heaven of heavens, with all dia army, di earth and all things wey dey on am, di seas and all wey dey inside dem, and you dey keep dem all, and di army of heaven dey worship you.
You na di Lord God, wey choose Abram and bring am out of Ur of di Chaldeans and give am di name Abraham.

You find im heart faithful before you and make covenant with am to give di land of di Canaanites, di Hittites, di Amorites, di Perizzites, di Jebusites and di Girgashites, to give am to im family. You don do wetin you talk, because you dey righteous.
You see di suffering of our papa dem for Egypt and hear dem cry by di Red Sea.
You show signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all im servants and against all di people of im land, because you know say dem treat dem with pride. You make name for yourself, as e be today.
You divide di sea before dem, so dat dem pass inside di sea for dry ground. Dem wey dey follow dem, you throw dem inside di deep, like stone inside strong water.
You lead dem for day with pillar of cloud, and for night with pillar of fire, to give dem light for di way wey dem suppose go.
You come down for Mount Sinai too and talk with dem from heaven. You give dem right rules and true laws, good commands and warnings,
and make your holy Sabbath known to dem, and command dem commands, warnings and law by Moses your servant.
You give dem bread from heaven for dem hunger and bring water out of di rock for dem thirst, and you command dem to go possess di land wey you don swear to give dem.
But dem and our papa dem dey proud and make dem neck hard, and dem no listen to your commands.

Dem refuse to obey, and dem no remember your wonders wey you do among dem, but dem make dem neck hard, and for dem rebellion dem appoint leader to return to dem slavery. But you be God wey ready to forgive, full of grace and mercy, slow to anger and plenty for faithful love, and you no leave dem.
Yes, even when dem make cast calf for dem self and talk say, ‘Dis na your God wey bring you up from Egypt,’ and dem do big insults,

still, because of your plenty mercies, you no leave dem for di wilderness. Di pillar of cloud no leave dem for day, to lead dem for di way, and di pillar of fire no leave dem for night, to show dem light and di way wey dem suppose go.
You give dem your good Spirit to teach dem, and you no hold back your manna from dem mouth, and you give dem water for dem thirst.
Yes, 40 years you take care of dem for di wilderness, and dem no lack anything. Dem clothes no old and dem feet no swell.
You give dem kingdoms and peoples too, wey you share to dem part by part. So dem possess di land of Sihon, even di land of di king of Heshbon, and di land of Og, king of Bashan.
You make dem pikin dem plenty like di stars of heaven and bring dem enter di land wey you talk to dem papa dem say dem go enter possess.

So di pikin dem enter and possess di land, and you beat di people wey dey stay for di land, di Canaanites, before dem. You give dem into dem hands, with dem kings and di peoples of di land, so dat dem go do to dem as dem like.

Dem take fortified cities and rich land, and possess houses full of all good things, wells wey dem don dig, vineyards, olive groves and plenty fruit trees. So dem eat, dem satisfy, dem grow fat and dem enjoy your great goodness.
Still, dem no obey, dem rebel against you, dem throw your law behind dem back and kill your prophets wey warn dem to turn dem back to you, and dem do big insults.

So you give dem into di hand of dem enemies, wey trouble dem. For di time of dem trouble, when dem cry to you, you hear from heaven, and according to your plenty mercies you give dem saviors wey save dem from di hand of dem enemies.

But after dem don rest, dem do evil again before you. So you leave dem for di hand of dem enemies, so dat dem rule over dem. Yet when dem return and cry to you, you hear from heaven, and plenty times you save dem according to your mercies,

and warn dem to bring dem back to your law. Yet dem dey proud and no listen to your commands, but dem sin against your rules, wey if person do am, e go live by dem, and dem turn dem shoulder away, make dem neck hard and no hear.
Yet plenty years you bear with dem and warn dem by your Spirit through your prophets, yet dem no gree listen. So you give dem into di hand of di peoples of di lands.
Still, because of your plenty mercies, you no finish dem and you no leave dem, because you be God full of grace and mercy.

Now our God, di great, di mighty and di fearful God, wey dey keep covenant and faithful love, no make all di hardship look small before you, wey don come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our papa dem and on all your people, from di time of di kings of Assyria until today.
Still you dey right for all wey don come on us, because you don do true, but we don do wicked.
Our kings, our princes, our priests and our papa dem no keep your law, and dem no listen to your commands and your warnings wey you warn dem with.
Because dem no serve you for dem kingdom, and for your great goodness wey you give dem, and for di wide and rich land wey you give dem, and dem no turn from dem wicked works.
Look, we be servants today, and for di land wey you give our papa dem to eat im fruit and im good things, look, we be servants inside am.
E dey give plenty increase to di kings wey you don put over us because of our sins. Dem get power over our bodies and over our animals as dem like, and we dey for big trouble.
Because of all dis we dey make sure covenant and write am, and our princes, our Levites and our priests dey put dem seal on am.
Now dem wey put seal na: Nehemiah di governor, Hacaliah pikin, and Zedekiah,
Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,
Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
Maaziah, Bilgai and Shemaiah. Dem na di priests.
Di Levites: Jeshua, Azaniah pikin, Binnui of di sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,
and dem brothers Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
Hodiah, Bani and Beninu.
Di chiefs of di people: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
Malluch, Harim and Baanah.

Di rest of di people, di priests, di Levites, di gatekeepers, di singers, di temple servants and all wey don separate dem self from di peoples of di lands to follow di law of God, dem wives, dem sons and dem daughters, everybody wey get knowledge and understanding,
join with dem brothers, dem nobles, and enter curse and oath to waka for God law, wey dem give by Moses, God servant, and to keep and do all di commands of di Lord our Lord, im rules and im warnings,
and say we no go give our daughters to di peoples of di land and no go take dem daughters for our sons.
If di peoples of di land bring goods or any grain to sell for Sabbath day, we no go buy from dem for Sabbath or for holy day. We go leave di seventh year and every debt.
We make rules for ourselves too, to charge ourselves every year one third of shekel for di service of di house of our God,

for di bread of di presence, for di continual grain offering, for di continual burnt offering, for di Sabbaths, di new moons, di set feasts, di holy things, di sin offerings to cover sin for Israel and for all di work of di house of our God.

We cast lots, di priests, di Levites and di people, for di wood offering, to bring am come di house of our God, by our papa houses, for set times, year by year, to burn on di altar of di Lord our God, as dem write am for di law,
and to bring di first fruits of our ground and di first fruits of all fruit of all kind of trees, year by year, to di Lord house,

also di first born of our sons and of our animals, as dem write am for di law, and di first born of our herds and flocks, to bring dem come di house of our God, to di priests wey dey serve for di house of our God,

and say we go bring di first of our dough, our offerings, di fruit of all kind of trees, di new wine and di oil to di priests, to di rooms of di house of our God, and di tenth of our ground to di Levites, because dem, di Levites, dey collect di tenth for all di cities of our farming.
Di priest, Aaron pikin, go dey with di Levites when di Levites dey collect di tenth, and di Levites go bring up di tenth of di tenth come di house of our God, to di rooms, to di treasure house.

Because di pikin dem of Israel and di pikin dem of Levi go bring di offering of di grain, di new wine and di oil to di rooms, where di vessels of di sanctuary dey, with di priests wey dey serve, di gatekeepers and di singers. We no go leave di house of our God.
Di princes of di people dey stay for Jerusalem. Di rest of di people cast lots too, to bring one out of every ten to stay for Jerusalem, di holy city, and nine parts for di other cities.
Di people bless all di men wey willingly offer dem self to stay for Jerusalem.

Now dis na di chiefs of di province wey dey stay for Jerusalem. But for di cities of Judah, each one dey stay for im own land for dem cities: Israel, di priests, di Levites, di temple servants and di pikin dem of Solomon servants.

For Jerusalem some of di pikin dem of Judah and of di pikin dem of Benjamin dey stay. Of di pikin dem of Judah: Athaiah, Uzziah pikin, Zechariah pikin, Amariah pikin, Shephatiah pikin, Mahalalel pikin, of di pikin dem of Perez,
and Maaseiah, Baruch pikin, Colhozeh pikin, Hazaiah pikin, Adaiah pikin, Joiarib pikin, Zechariah pikin, di son of di Shilonite.
All di sons of Perez wey dey stay for Jerusalem na 468 brave men.
Dis na di sons of Benjamin: Sallu, Meshullam pikin, Joed pikin, Pedaiah pikin, Kolaiah pikin, Maaseiah pikin, Ithiel pikin, Jeshaiah pikin.
After am, Gabbai and Sallai, 928.
Joel, Zichri pikin, na dem overseer, and Judah, Hassenuah pikin, dey second over di city.
Of di priests: Jedaiah, Joiarib pikin, and Jachin,
Seraiah, Hilkiah pikin, Meshullam pikin, Zadok pikin, Meraioth pikin, Ahitub pikin, di ruler of God house,
and dem brothers wey dey do di work of di house, 822. Adaiah, Jeroham pikin, Pelaliah pikin, Amzi pikin, Zechariah pikin, Pashhur pikin, Malchijah pikin,
and im brothers, chiefs of papa houses, 242. Amashsai, Azarel pikin, Ahzai pikin, Meshillemoth pikin, Immer pikin,
and dem brothers, brave mighty men, 128. Dem overseer na Zabdiel, Haggedolim pikin.
Of di Levites: Shemaiah, Hasshub pikin, Azrikam pikin, Hashabiah pikin, Bunni pikin,
and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of di chiefs of di Levites, wey dey oversee di outside work of God house,
and Mattaniah, Mica pikin, Zabdi pikin, Asaph pikin, wey be di chief to begin di thanks prayer, and Bakbukiah, wey dey second among im brothers, and Abda, Shammua pikin, Galal pikin, Jeduthun pikin.
All di Levites for di holy city na 284.
Di gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon and dem brothers wey dey watch di gates, na 172.
Di rest of Israel, of di priests and di Levites, dey for all di cities of Judah, each one for im own inheritance.
But di temple servants dey stay for Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa dey over di temple servants.
Di overseer of di Levites for Jerusalem na Uzzi, Bani pikin, Hashabiah pikin, Mattaniah pikin, Mica pikin, of di sons of Asaph, di singers, over di work of God house.
Because command dey from di king about dem, and fixed support dey for di singers, as every day need.
Pethahiah, Meshezabel pikin, of di pikin dem of Zerah, Judah pikin, dey di king side for all matters about di people.
As for di villages with dem fields, some of di pikin dem of Judah dey stay for Kiriath Arba with im towns, for Dibon with im towns and for Jekabzeel with im villages,
for Jeshua, for Moladah, for Beth Pelet,
for Hazar Shual, for Beersheba with im towns,
for Ziklag, for Meconah with im towns,
for En Rimmon, for Zorah, for Jarmuth,
Zanoah, Adullam, with dem villages, Lachish with im fields and Azekah with im towns. So dem camp from Beersheba reach di valley of Hinnom.
Di pikin dem of Benjamin dey stay from Geba go forward, for Michmash, Aija, Bethel with im towns,
for Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
Lod and Ono, di valley of craftsmen.
Of di Levites, some groups for Judah join Benjamin.
Now dis na di priests and di Levites wey go up with Zerubbabel, Shealtiel pikin, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah and Jedaiah. Dem na di chiefs of di priests and of dem brothers for di days of Jeshua.
Di Levites too: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah and Mattaniah, wey dey over di thanksgiving, e and im brothers.
Bakbukiah and Unno, dem brothers, dey opposite dem according to dem work.
Jeshua born Joiakim, Joiakim born Eliashib, Eliashib born Joiada,
Joiada born Jonathan, and Jonathan born Jaddua.
For di days of Joiakim, priests dey wey be heads of papa houses: of Seraiah, Meraiah. Of Jeremiah, Hananiah.
Of Ezra, Meshullam. Of Amariah, Jehohanan.
Of Malluchi, Jonathan. Of Shebaniah, Joseph.
Of Harim, Adna. Of Meraioth, Helkai.
Of Iddo, Zechariah. Of Ginnethon, Meshullam.
Of Abijah, Zichri. Of Miniamin and Moadiah, Piltai.
Of Bilgah, Shammua. Of Shemaiah, Jehonathan.
Of Joiarib, Mattenai. Of Jedaiah, Uzzi.
Of Sallai, Kallai. Of Amok, Eber.
Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah. Of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
As for di Levites, for di days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan and Jaddua, dem write down di heads of papa houses. Di priests too, for di rule of Darius di Persian.
Dem write di sons of Levi, heads of papa houses, for di book of di history, even until di days of Johanan, Eliashib pikin.

Di chiefs of di Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah and Jeshua, Kadmiel pikin, with dem brothers opposite dem, to praise and give thanks, according to di command of David di man of God, one group after di other.
Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon and Akkub na gatekeepers wey dey watch di store houses of di gates.
Dem dey for di days of Joiakim, Jeshua pikin, Jozadak pikin, and for di days of Nehemiah di governor and of Ezra di priest and teacher.

For di dedication of di wall of Jerusalem, dem look for di Levites from all dem places to bring dem come Jerusalem, to keep di dedication with gladness, with thanks and with singing, with cymbals, harps and lyres.
Di sons of di singers gather together, both from di plain round Jerusalem and from di villages of di Netophathites,
from Beth Gilgal too and from di fields of Geba and Azmaveth, because di singers don build villages for dem self round Jerusalem.
Di priests and di Levites make dem self clean, and dem clean di people, di gates and di wall.
Den I bring di princes of Judah up on di wall and appoint two big groups wey give thanks and go for procession. One go to di right hand on di wall toward di Dung Gate.
After dem go Hoshaiah and half of di princes of Judah,
and Azariah, Ezra and Meshullam,
Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah and Jeremiah,
and some of di priests sons with trumpets: Zechariah, Jonathan pikin, Shemaiah pikin, Mattaniah pikin, Micaiah pikin, Zaccur pikin, Asaph pikin,
and im brothers Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah and Hanani, with di music instruments of David di man of God. Ezra di teacher dey before dem.
By di Fountain Gate, and straight before dem, dem go up by di steps of David city, for di way up of di wall, above David house, reach di Water Gate for east.
Di other group of dem wey give thanks go meet dem, and I follow after dem with half of di people on di wall, above di Tower of di Ovens, reach di Broad Wall,
and above di Gate of Ephraim, by di Old Gate, by di Fish Gate, di Tower of Hananel and di Tower of Hammeah, reach di Sheep Gate. Dem stop for di Gate of di Guard.
So di two groups of dem wey give thanks stand for God house, and me, and half of di rulers with me,
and di priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah and Hananiah, with trumpets,
and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam and Ezer. Di singers sing loud, with Jezrahiah dem overseer.
Dem offer big sacrifices dat day and rejoice, because God don make dem rejoice with big joy. Di women and di pikin dem rejoice too, so di joy of Jerusalem dey hear from far.

For dat day dem appoint men over di rooms for di treasures, for di offerings, for di first fruits and for di tenth, to gather inside dem, according to di fields of di cities, di shares wey di law set for di priests and Levites, because Judah rejoice over di priests and di Levites wey dey serve.
Dem do di service of dem God and di service of di cleaning, and di singers and di gatekeepers do am too, according to di command of David and of Solomon im pikin.
Because for di days of David and Asaph from long time, chiefs of di singers dey, and songs of praise and thanks to God.

All Israel for di days of Zerubbabel and for di days of Nehemiah give di shares of di singers and di gatekeepers, as every day need. Dem set apart wetin belong to di Levites, and di Levites set apart wetin belong to Aaron sons.
For dat day dem read from di book of Moses for di ears of di people, and dem find write inside am say Ammonite and Moabite no go enter di gathering of God forever,
because dem no meet di pikin dem of Israel with bread and water, but dem hire Balaam against dem to curse dem. Still our God turn di curse to blessing.
E happen say when dem hear di law, dem separate from Israel all di mixed people.
Now before dis, Eliashib di priest, wey dem appoint over di rooms of di house of our God, wey dey close to Tobiah,

don prepare big room for am, where before dem dey put di grain offerings, di incense, di vessels and di tenth of di grain, di new wine and di oil, wey dem give by command to di Levites, di singers and di gatekeepers, and di offerings for di priests.
But for all dis time I no dey Jerusalem, because for di 32nd year of Artaxerxes, king of Babylon, I go meet di king. After some days I ask di king for permission,
and I come Jerusalem and see di evil wey Eliashib do for Tobiah, as e prepare room for am for di courts of God house.
E pain me well well, so I throw all Tobiah house things out of di room.
Den I command, and dem clean di rooms, and I bring di vessels of God house back there, with di grain offerings and di incense.
I know say dem no give di Levites dem share, so di Levites and di singers wey dey do di work don run, each one go im farm.
Den I argue with di rulers and talk say, “Why dem don leave God house?” I gather dem together and put dem for dem place.
Den all Judah bring di tenth of di grain, di new wine and di oil to di store rooms.

I make treasurers over di store rooms, Shelemiah di priest, Zadok di teacher, and of di Levites, Pedaiah, and next to dem Hanan, Zaccur pikin, Mattaniah pikin, because dem count dem faithful, and na dem work to share to dem brothers.
Remember me, my God, about dis, and no wipe out my good deeds wey I don do for di house of my God and for im service.

For dem days I see for Judah some men dey press grapes for Sabbath, dey bring in bundles of grain and dey load donkeys with wine, grapes, figs and all kind of load, and dey bring dem enter Jerusalem for Sabbath day. I warn dem for di day wey dem sell food.
Men of Tyre dey stay there too, wey dey bring fish and all kind of goods and sell for Sabbath to di pikin dem of Judah and for Jerusalem.
Den I argue with di nobles of Judah and talk to dem say, “Wetin be dis evil thing wey una dey do, wey una dey spoil di Sabbath day?
No be so una papa dem do, and our God bring all dis evil on us and on dis city? Yet una dey bring more anger on Israel by spoiling di Sabbath.”

E happen say when di gates of Jerusalem begin to dark before di Sabbath, I command say make dem close di doors, and I command say make dem no open dem until after di Sabbath. I put some of my servants over di gates, so dat no load go enter for Sabbath day.
So di traders and sellers of all kind of goods sleep outside Jerusalem one time or two times.
Den I warn dem and talk to dem say, “Why una dey sleep before di wall? If una do am again, I go lay hands on una.” From dat time dem no come again for Sabbath.
I command di Levites say make dem clean dem self and come keep di gates, to make di Sabbath day holy. Remember me for dis too, my God, and spare me according to di greatness of your faithful love.
For dem days too I see Jews wey don marry women of Ashdod, of Ammon and of Moab,
and dem pikin dem talk half for di language of Ashdod and no fit talk di Jews language, but di language of each people.
I argue with dem, curse dem, beat some of dem and pull dem hair, and make dem swear by God say, “Una no go give una daughters to dem sons and no go take dem daughters for una sons or for una self.

No be Solomon, king of Israel, sin because of dis things? Yet among plenty nations no king like am dey, and im God love am, and God make am king over all Israel. Still, strange women make even am sin.
So make we listen to una to do all dis big evil, to do wrong against our God by marrying strange women?”
One of di sons of Joiada, Eliashib di high priest pikin, na son-in-law to Sanballat di Horonite, so I drive am away from me.
Remember dem, my God, because dem don make di priesthood dirty and di covenant of di priesthood and of di Levites.
So I clean dem from all strangers and appoint duties for di priests and for di Levites, each one for im work,
and for di wood offering for set times, and for di first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.
